    deletes any <name>.json with no matching agent
    record. It leaves dispatch-* files to the
    dispatcher's own sweep, and deletes nothing if
    the agent records file can't be read. The orphan
    test failed on a stub first.
  - Gap: an agent renamed while live that is still
    running at the next daemon restart gets adopted,
    and it's still using <old>.json when the sweep
    deletes it. So a live rename followed by a daemon
    restart has the same hot-reload risk as before.
